trade_name: NOS ICT Satellite TV Antenna Installation and Maintenance

learning_outcomes.description: Principles and Practices of Health and Safety

performance_criteria.description: Conduct a detailed risk assessment for satellite installation activities, focusing on potential hazards such as working at heights, electrical risks, and falling objects.
Explain new hazards that may arise from changing weather conditions, site layout, or complex installations (e.g., urban vs. rural environments).
Demonstrate control measures to mitigate identified hazards, including the use of barriers, warning signs, and proper work zoning.
Know importance of implementing control measures through continuous monitoring during the installation process.

learning_outcomes.description: Application of Advanced Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and Safety Gear

performance_criteria.description: Identify appropriate PPE specific to complex satellite installations, such as full-body harnesses, shock-absorbing lanyards, and insulated gloves for electrical safety.
Demonstrate procedures for inspecting and maintaining PPE to ensure functionality, including checking expiration dates and performing routine equipment inspections.
Explain the importance of ergonomics when selecting PPE for extended periods of use, particularly for tasks involving repetitive movements or working in awkward positions.
Perform a safety drill involving the use of PPE, simulating emergency situations (e.g., a fall or electrical shock) and demonstrating proper response techniques

learning_outcomes.description: Emergency Preparedness and Response Procedures

performance_criteria.description: Develop emergency response plans specific to satellite installations, addressing fire, electrical hazards, and working at heights emergencies.
Explain role of emergency evacuation plans and the importance of identifying and maintaining clear escape routes during large installations.
Demonstrate emergency communication devices (e.g., two-way radios, emergency alarms) to notify team members and emergency services during a crisis.
Carry out emergency evacuation drill, where learners practice responding to an incident such as a fire or medical emergency, ensuring all safety protocols are followed.

learning_outcomes.description: Advanced Professional Communication Techniques

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate clear and concise verbal communication to convey technical instructions and safety guidelines during satellite installation projects.
Explain active listening techniques in discussions with team members and clients, ensuring that feedback and concerns are understood and addressed.
Explain tailoring communication to suit the audience, such as using technical language with colleagues and simplified explanations for clients or non-technical personnel.
Role-playing exercise where learners manage communication between team members and clients, focusing on clarity, tone, and professionalism.

learning_outcomes.description: Handling Communication in High-Pressure Situations

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate maintain composure and use effective communication during high-pressure scenarios, such as project delays or safety incidents.
Explain assertive communication to resolve conflicts within a team or with clients without escalating the situation.
Apply de-escalation techniques when communicating with clients or team members who may be upset or frustrated due to unforeseen project challenges.
Simulate situation where learners must communicate effectively with both their team and clients to resolve a project issue or safety concern.

learning_outcomes.description: Digital Communication Tools for Remote Work and Team Coordination

performance_criteria.description: Use of digital communication tools (e.g., email, project management software, messaging apps) for coordinating remote teams during satellite installations.
Explain the importance of keeping detailed digital communication records, including email chains, project updates, and client feedback, to ensure accountability and traceability.
Know Role of video conferencing and virtual collaboration tools in facilitating communication between geographically distributed teams.
Demonstrate monitoring remote satellite installation project using digital communication tools.

learning_outcomes.description: Advanced Team Dynamics and Leadership Skills

performance_criteria.description: Explain roles and responsibilities within a satellite installation team.
Demonstrate leadership techniques that promote team cohesion.
Discuss the importance of adaptability within a team.
Conduct a group exercise where learners assume different leadership roles and work on solving a project challenge, applying team dynamics and leadership principles.

learning_outcomes.description: Collaborative Problem-Solving in Satellite Installation Projects

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate complex satellite installation challenges
Apply critical thinking and collaborative decision-making techniques.
Explain time management in collaborative work.
Perform a group task where trainees must collaboratively solve a technical problem (e.g., a signal issue) using effective communication, resource allocation, and decision-making skills.

learning_outcomes.description: Building Trust and Accountability in Teams

performance_criteria.description: Discuss the role of trust in high-functioning teams and how establishing clear expectations and transparency leads to better collaboration and accountability.
Explain the impact of individual accountability on team success, focusing on how each member’s contribution affects the overall project outcome.
Demonstrate techniques for providing constructive feedback and encouraging self-assessment to improve performance and foster accountability in a team setting.
Conduct an activity where learners give and receive feedback within a team, focusing on building trust and accountability through open communication and mutual respect.

units.title: TOOLS AND EQUIPMENT FOR SATELLITE TV ANTENNA INSTALLATION

learning_outcomes.description: Basic Tools (Standard for All Levels)

performance_criteria.description: Describe basic tools such as Screwdrivers (Phillips, flathead), Drills (corded or cordless), Wrenches and Ratchets, Wire cutters/Strippers, Pliers, and cables ties
Discuss different types and brands of tools. For example, compare cordless vs. corded drills for different installation environments (e.g., residential vs. commercial).
Select tools based on installation needs, including durability, power, and adaptability to different job types.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the procedure of Mounting Satellite TV Equipment

performance_criteria.description: Identify the necessary tools, materials, and safety gear required for the installation.
Inspect the satellite dish and related equipment for defects or damage.
Use appropriate tools to securely mount the dish on walls, poles, or other structures.
Use a satellite signal meter or compatible software to locate the satellite and optimize signal strength.
Use weather-resistant coaxial cables and connectors for outdoor installations.
Connect the satellite receiver to the TV and verify signal input.
Use ladders, harnesses, or other equipment to ensure safe working conditions at heights.
Demonstrate the ability to troubleshoot minor signal or connectivity issues.

learning_outcomes.description: Introduction to Digital and Software Tools for Satellite Alignment

performance_criteria.description: use digital satellite finders to achieve precise satellite alignment.
Use smartphone apps and software-based tools to calculate azimuth, elevation, and polarization angles based on geographic location.
Compare the accuracy and ease of use between traditional manual tools and digital alignment tools for both commercial and residential installations.

learning_outcomes.description: Calibration and Maintenance Tools for Satellite Equipment

performance_criteria.description: Discuss the importance of regular calibration and maintenance of satellite installation tools, such as signal meters, oscilloscopes, and calibration kits.
Calibrate a signal strength meter for accurate readings during dish alignment and maintenance.
Use electrical test tools (e.g., multimeters) to diagnose power supply issues and faulty components in satellite receivers and amplifiers.
Perform routine maintenance on installation tools, including testing signal accuracy, recalibrating tools, and ensuring the integrity of cables and connectors.

units.title: ADVANCED SATELLITE DISH SETTING AND CONFIGURATIONS

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Dish Alignment and Tracking

performance_criteria.description: Discuss Dish Alignment with Geostationary Satellite
Discuss Motorized Satellite Antennas (DiSEqC Motor)
Program DiSEqC (Digital Satellite Equipment Control)
Explain Polar Mount Systems
Troubleshooting common issues with polar mount systems, such as misalignment or motor failure

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Multiswitch Systems

performance_criteria.description: Describe Single Satellite to Multiple Receiver Setup
Discuss Multisatellite Configuration
Configure Cascade Systems for Apartment Buildings

learning_outcomes.description: Signal Distribution and Integration

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate Signal Amplification and Attenuation
Diagnose issues related to signal degradation over long cable runs.
Fix issues found in 3.2
Combine Satellite TV with Terrestrial (TV Aerial) Signals
Discuss SMATV (Satellite Master Antenna Television)

learning_outcomes.description: Testing and Troubleshooting Advanced Satellite Systems

performance_criteria.description: Use Spectrum Analyzer for Interference Detection
Identify different types of interference (e.g., electromagnetic, signal overlap) and how to resolve them.
Use Field Strength Meters for signal detection
Perform Satellite Receiver Firmware Updates
Identify Cable Faults
Resolve 4.5

units.title: TESTING AND TROUBLESHOOTING ADVANCED SATELLITE SYSTEMS

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Advanced Signal Testing Tools

performance_criteria.description: Use Advanced Spectrum Analyser for Satellite Systems
Explain Signal Path Analysis and Optimization
Advanced Receiver Diagnostics
Signal Quality and Modulation Schemes

learning_outcomes.description: Global Best Practices and Standards

performance_criteria.description: Discuss Best Practices for Multi-Satellite Systems
Explain Standards for High-Frequency Satellite Systems
Explain Global Standards for Satellite Security
Discuss Environmental and Sustainability Standards for Satellite Installations

learning_outcomes.description: Signal Optimization Techniques for Satellite Systems

performance_criteria.description: Discuss advanced techniques for optimizing signal quality, including the use of adaptive modulation and coding (ACM) to adjust for changes in weather and interference.
Explain the role of error correction methods like forward error correction (FEC) in improving signal integrity and data throughput.
Demonstrate the optimization of satellite dish alignment for multi-beam satellites or high-throughput satellite (HTS) networks
Explore techniques for optimizing uplink power control to minimize interference and maintain signal quality in variable atmospheric conditions.

learning_outcomes.description: Advanced Troubleshooting of Satellite Ground Systems

performance_criteria.description: Explain the process of troubleshooting uplink and downlink systems, focusing on signal interference, attenuation, and equipment calibration.
Troubleshoot issues with satellite modems, signal amplifiers, and low-noise block downconverters (LNBs).
Resolve issues in 4.2
Identify common causes of signal attenuation in long-distance cable runs and how to mitigate these issues using repeaters and amplifiers.
Troubleshoot satellite ground equipment
Explore techniques for maintaining redundancy in satellite ground systems.
